notes: Fitted by speed.fit() from measurements.json (role=fit rows only); regenerate with `amagi-inference-calc calibrate --refit`.
Decode bandwidth is ~1.03x the memtest_vulkan read/write figure (737.8 GB/s) and 0.81x the 936 GB/s spec.
Dense batching cost is derived from prefill FLOPs, not measured. MoE prefill is rough (held-out error up to ~60%).
_about: Speed-model constants for one RTX 3090 (300 W limit, llama.cpp CUDA, f16 KV).
